defect: The new else-branch calls DelayWrite() from the nonmem write-queue leader in WriteImplWALOnly, but DelayWrite stalls through write_thread_.BeginWriteStall() on the primary queue, whose leader this thread is not, violating its REQUIRES precondition (LinkOne assertion, one queue left stuck on stopped writes).
reason: The fix makes DelayWrite operate on the caller's own write queue, repairing exactly the call this change added; its message names #11020 as the cause.

defect: The new header declares virtual ~WriteControllerToken() = default while the derived token destructors are declared without exception specification, which fails to compile on GCC 4.7 (looser throw specifier), a compiler RocksDB supported at the time.
reason: Fix #284 only rewrites these newly added destructor declarations to work around the gcc 4.7 compile error; the code is valid C++11, so the failure is compiler-specific.

defect: The new branch compares against 1000000l * 60 * 60, which overflows a 32-bit long on i386 (undefined behaviour and an -Werror=overflow build failure).
reason: The fix changes exactly this added constant to long long.

defect: The new anonymous-namespace helper IsSectorAligned has the same name as the helper in env/io_posix.cc, so the unity build that concatenates all sources fails to compile.
reason: The fix only renames the added helper to IsFileSectorAligned to repair the unity build; the clash is visible only with io_posix.cc.

defect: The fix relaxes the new OpenWhenOpen assertion from a prefix match on the lock message to a substring match so the test passes with the Windows error text.
reason: This is a test-only adjustment of an over-strict platform-specific expectation; no product or build defect was introduced.

defect: The fix extends the new BloomSchema test's hard-coded false-positive pattern to CACHE_LINE_SIZE 128 and 256 instead of assuming 64.
reason: Test change: the fix adds expected patterns for other cache line sizes to a regression test; nothing in the product code was wrong.

defect: kLen is computed as (total_bits + 8*block_bytes - 1)/64, which does not round up to a whole number of blocks, so probing x ^ i can index past the allocated array (out-of-bounds access found by valgrind).
reason: The fix recomputes kLen as a multiple of the block size in exactly the lines this change added.

defect: SetIsInSecondaryCache() is called after Promote(), which has already inserted the handle into the shared cache, so the non-atomic flag update races with other threads using the handle.
reason: The fix moves the added SetIsInSecondaryCache call before Promote, repairing the data race this change introduced.

defect: The new FlushSchedule test declares std::atomic<int> thread_num without initializing it, so fetch_add reads an indeterminate value (valgrind uninitialized-value error, wrong seeds and column-family split).
reason: The fix initializes thread_num(0) in the test code this change added.

defect: The fix moves and renames the test sync point (ClearError to ErrorCleared) to after RecoverFromBGError so a test can wait for recovery to finish.
reason: Test-infrastructure change to deflake error_handler_test; the sync point placement has no effect on product behaviour.

defect: The new log line prints live_wal_files.size() (size_t) with %ld, a format mismatch that is undefined behaviour and a -Wformat error where size_t is not long.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added format specifier with ROCKSDB_PRIszt.

defect: The new BackupFileTemperature test opens a BackupEngine through a raw pointer and never deletes it, leaking it (valgrind failure).
reason: The fix wraps the added BackupEngine pointer in a unique_ptr, repairing a leak in this change's lines.

defect: The new condition !FLAGS_avoid_flush_during_shutdown is inverted: the WAL is left unsynced exactly when shutdown does not flush and reopen relies on the WAL, causing spurious data-loss verification failures.
reason: The fix flips this added condition, which contradicted the change's own stated intent of skipping SyncWAL only when flushing during shutdown.

defect: Meant to give Directory::Close() a default implementation, the change instead turned WritableFile::Close() from pure virtual into a NotSupported default, changing the wrong public interface and leaving Directory::Close pure virtual.
reason: The fix reverts WritableFile::Close to pure virtual and puts the default on Directory, repairing the line this change modified.

defect: Adding a new pure virtual FSDirectory::Close() to a public interface breaks every out-of-tree FSDirectory implementation (backward-incompatible API, compile failure).
reason: The fix gives the added FSDirectory::Close a NotSupported default, repairing the broken interface this change introduced.

defect: DestroyDB now returns the failure of DeleteDir on the archive directory, which does not exist when WAL archiving is off, so DestroyDB reports an error on a normal database.
reason: The fix ignores the DeleteDir status in exactly the lines this change added.

defect: ASSERT_EQ(0, arena.ApproximateMemoryUsage()) compares int with size_t, a sign-compare warning that breaks the -Wall -Werror build.
reason: The fix changes this added assertion to compare against a size_t constant to remove the compile error.

defect: The new assertions compare int literals and int n with the size_t GetUsage() result (signed/unsigned), which fails to compile on Mac with -Werror.
reason: The fix only makes these added comparisons unsigned to repair the Mac compile errors.

defect: The fix makes the test pick the first supported compression type other than kNoCompression, since GetSupportedCompressions() can return kNoCompression first.
reason: Test-only change correcting the test's own setup logic; no product or build defect.

defect: start_time is set only in the timed-delay branch, but delayed can also become true in the stop-wait loop, so time_delayed becomes NowMicros() - 0 and huge bogus stall times are recorded.
reason: The fix sets start_time before the branch, repairing the line this change introduced.

defect: The added forward declaration enum EntryType; is not valid ISO C++ for an unscoped enum without fixed underlying type and redeclares an enum already defined in types.h, failing clang builds with -Wgnu-redeclared-enum and -Werror.
reason: The fix just removes this added line to repair the clang build.

defect: The new Windows truncate() emulation opens the file with share mode 0, so it fails whenever the file is open elsewhere, unlike POSIX truncate, and the existing db_test WAL-truncation tests fail on Windows.
reason: The fix changes this added CreateFile share mode to allow sharing; the failing behaviour comes from the new port code.

defect: The added iter.release() drops the iterator pointer without deleting it, leaking the iterator and causing the valgrind failure.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added line.

defect: The new OnTableFileCreated override lacks the override keyword while its sibling method has it, failing clang builds with -Winconsistent-missing-override and -Werror.
reason: The fix adds override to this added method.

defect: The rewritten assert compares the unsigned expression kBlockSize - block_offset_ with the int kHeaderSize, a signed/unsigned comparison that fails to compile with -Werror on some compilers.
reason: The fix adds the int cast to exactly this changed assert, which the change's title promised but did not do.

defect: The new io_uring tests register SyncPoint callbacks that capture locals by reference and never clear them, so later tests in the same process fire stale callbacks on dangling references and fail.
reason: The fix clears the callbacks in the added tests and in the fixture destructor, repairing this change's lines.

defect: In UpdateCurrent, int cmp = Compare(...) > 0 stores a boolean, so cmp is never negative and assert(cmp != 0) fires whenever the mutable key is the smaller one.
reason: The fix removes the stray > 0 in this newly added code.

defect: Declaring the pure virtual Callback with a const bool parameter while the overriders use plain bool triggers MSVC warning C4373, which fails the default /WX Windows build with VS 2015.
reason: The fix drops the const from this changed signature; the mismatch shows only together with the overriders in other files.

defect: In MultiThreadReplay the newly allocated ReplayerWorkerArg ra is not freed when ReadTrace fails and the loop breaks, leaking it.
reason: The fix deletes ra on that path in the code this change added.

defect: The fix makes the new IgnoreRecoveredLog test create the DB directory before creating its backup_logs subdirectory.
reason: Test setup fix only; no product or build defect.

defect: TestMultiScan sets ro.iterate_upper_bound to a loop-local Slice only after the iterator under test was created, so that iterator never gets the bound that VerifyIterator assumes and the pointer dangles across iterations.
reason: The fix sets a function-scope upper bound before NewIterator, repairing the stress-test lines this change added.

defect: The new __no_sanitize__ attribute is applied for any clang, but clang before 3.9 does not support it, breaking the Travis build with clang 3.6.
reason: The fix restricts this added attribute to clang 3.9 and later.

defect: CurrentOptions() assigns NewFixedPrefixTransform(8) to the raw-pointer Options::prefix_extractor on every call, leaking a SliceTransform each time (valgrind).
reason: The fix replaces the added allocation with one static owned transform; that prefix_extractor is a raw pointer is visible only in options.h.

defect: The new CompactionServiceInput::options_file_number member has no initializer, so the existing InputSerialization unit test serializes an uninitialized value (valgrind failure).
reason: The fix adds a default initializer to this added field (and to the pre-existing output_level); the uninitialized read happens in a test in another file.

defect: The new unit-suffix assertions compare unsigned option fields with signed int and long long literals, which fails clang compilation with -Werror sign-compare.
reason: The fix makes the literals in these added assertions unsigned.

defect: With several background threads, Schedule still signals only when the queue was empty, so tasks enqueued while one worker is busy never wake the other idle workers.
reason: The signal-when-empty logic was correct for the single thread before; this change added multiple workers without adapting it, and the fix signals on every enqueue.

defect: The per-edit printing was added inside Recover(), where neither verbose nor count exists, so version_set.cc no longer compiles.
reason: The fix moves this added block into DumpManifest and is titled as fixing the compilation error introduced by this commit.

defect: obsolete_manifests_ is appended in LogAndApply while the DB mutex is released, racing with GetObsoleteFiles, which swaps the same vector under the mutex.
reason: The fix moves the added emplace_back to after mu->Lock().

defect: ASSERT_EQ(int_num, 0) and ASSERT_EQ(int_num, 4) compare uint64_t with int, failing the Mac -Werror build.
reason: The fix makes these added literals unsigned.

defect: The new fprintf prints the size_t block_size with %lu, a format mismatch on 32-bit platforms (undefined behaviour, -Wformat failure on linux32).
reason: The fix changes this added format to ROCKSDB_PRIszt.
